# Gajab TestAutothon Change Review

## Scope

- Requirement or risk covered:
- Files changed:
- AI agent or prompt used:

## Validation

- Build/test command run:
- Browsers/platforms checked:
- Artifacts captured:
- Sprint memory updated:

## Review Checklist

- [ ] Uses only `https://stg.gajab.com/` or authorized local/test dependencies.
- [ ] No secrets, real OTPs, private phone numbers, personal data, or credentials committed.
- [ ] Test logic is separated from page objects, data, and configuration.
- [ ] Locators follow [docs/ai/locator-strategy.md](../docs/ai/locator-strategy.md).
- [ ] Assertions verify business-visible outcomes, not only clicks.
- [ ] Reports, logs, screenshots, traces, or videos are useful for judges.
- [ ] Fallbacks are documented for unavailable products, filters, or payment dependencies.
- [ ] AI-generated content was reviewed and recorded in [docs/ai/ai-usage-report.md](../docs/ai/ai-usage-report.md).
